meta.source: Hand-edited: USTR Section 301 notices, Section 232 proclamations, the Section 122 proclamation and HTSUS chapter 99, as summarized in the sources of each entry
meta.note: Additional duties change by notice. Each entry has its own effective dates and source; entries with verified=false were not checked against the official list and the estimate says so. Edit this file (or drop a newer copy in DUTY_DATA_DIR) when a notice changes them. IEEPA tariffs were held unlawful on 2026-02-20 (Learning Resources v. Trump) and are kept only for estimates of earlier entries.

entries.description: Products of China on USTR List 1
entries.source: USTR, 83 FR 28710 (List 1); HTSUS 9903.88.01 and U.S. note 20(b) to subchapter III of chapter 99
entries.note: Coverage listed for the subheadings DocCheck's sample goods use; confirm the 8-digit line against note 20(b) and any exclusion (9903.88.69/70).

entries.description: Products of China on USTR List 3
entries.source: USTR, 83 FR 47974 and 84 FR 20459 (List 3); HTSUS 9903.88.03 and U.S. note 20(f)
entries.note: Confirm the 8-digit line against U.S. note 20(f).

entries.description: Products of China on USTR List 4A
entries.source: USTR, 85 FR 3741 (List 4A at 7.5 %); HTSUS 9903.88.15 and U.S. note 20(s)
entries.note: Most apparel of chapters 61-62 is on List 4A; confirm against U.S. note 20(s).

entries.description: Steel content of derivative products added by the August 2025 inclusions
entries.source: Proclamation 10947 (50 % on steel and aluminum content, June 2025) and the BIS inclusions notice of August 2025
entries.note: Charged on the value of the steel content only, which the invoice does not give: the estimate uses the whole line value until the steel content is entered, and says so. Confirm that the 8-digit line is on the inclusions list.

entries.description: Products of China and Hong Kong
entries.source: Executive Order of 2025-11-04 (rate cut from 20 % to 10 %); held unlawful by the Supreme Court on 2026-02-20
entries.note: No longer collected. Kept for estimates of entries made while it applied; refunds are being processed.

entries.description: Reciprocal tariff on products of China during the suspension of the higher rate
entries.source: Executive Order 14257 as modified; held unlawful on 2026-02-20

entries.description: Reciprocal tariff on products of Vietnam
entries.source: Executive Order 14326 (Annex I); held unlawful on 2026-02-20

entries.program: IEEPA reciprocal tariff and Russian-oil tariff (India)
entries.description: Reciprocal tariff (25 %) and the additional 25 % on products of India
entries.source: Executive Orders 14326 and 14329; held unlawful on 2026-02-20

entries.description: 15 % in total including the regular duty, on products of the EU
entries.source: Executive Order 14326 as amended for the EU framework; held unlawful on 2026-02-20

entries.description: 10 % baseline on origins without a country rate
entries.note: Many origins had higher country rates from 2025-08-07; only the baseline is kept here.

entries.description: Temporary import surcharge on all origins
entries.source: Proclamation under section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 (150 days); expired by statute
entries.note: The proclamation exempted some goods (energy, certain agricultural products); they are not listed here.

entries.source: USTR final action in the Section 301 forced-labor investigations; HTSUS 2026 Revision 13 (9903.05.20-9903.05.98)
entries.note: Stacks on the China Section 301 lists. Goods under Section 232 are excluded (9903.05.90).

entries.description: 10 % in total including the regular duty, on products of the EU
entries.source: USTR final action; HTSUS 2026 Revision 13 (9903.05.38 when the regular duty is already 10 % or more)
entries.note: The EU's own exemption list (9903.05.96-98) is not included.

entries.description: Products of Canada not entered free under USMCA
entries.source: USTR final action; HTSUS 2026 Revision 13 (USMCA exemption 9903.05.93)

entries.description: Products of Mexico not entered free under USMCA
entries.source: USTR final action; HTSUS 2026 Revision 13 (USMCA exemption 9903.05.94)
